name: EventViewer
tagline: Windows 11 Event Viewer, Unified Log & Diagnostic Suite
short_description: Native macOS event exploration with optional rounded desktop Cards, a visual widget gallery, eight event graph styles, scoped buffered-event summaries, event inspectors and correlation maps.
spotlight_description: EventViewer 1.3 adds a six-preview widget gallery and optional Cards presentation, matching PerfMon. Choose eight graph styles for selected buffered event streams, with adaptive or fixed event-rate scaling. Existing Classic HUDs, saved views, token layouts and settings remain compatible.
